payout_quote: Official JuryTest FAQ: 'How much you get paid will depend on the case, but usually between $20 and $50 per case.' You are informed up front of the case fee and time commitment, usually 20-50 minutes. Payment via PayPal or check.
timing: Not precisely stated — you are told the case fee and time commitment up front; payment via PayPal or check.
biggest_catch: Cases depend on your geography and available cases — opportunities may be unavailable for weeks, so income is irregular.
catches: Opportunities may be unavailable for weeks depending on geography and case availability.
Pay is $20–$50 per case ('usually') — not a guaranteed $50.
You must be matched to a case's venue/demographics.
steps: Go to https://www.jurytest.net/ and register as a prospective juror.
Wait for case invitations in your area and complete the qualification screener.
Note the case fee and time commitment you are told up front (usually 20-50 minutes, usually $20–$50).
Complete the online case review and receive payment via PayPal or check.
eligibility: Must meet case venue/demographic requirements; availability varies by geography.
notes: Verified against the official JuryTest FAQ (jurytest.net) observed 2026-09-23. The route claims $50 — official says 'usually between $20 and $50 per case', so $50 is the top of the usual range. The app must present the range and the availability catch.
